The young forward composed himself before driving a low shot into the bottom left corner to make it 1-0. The goal sparked a reaction from Wrexham , who made a triple substitution shortly after, introducing Kieffer Moore , Bailey Cadamarteri , and Benjamin Whiteman to find an equalizer. As the clock ticked down, the game became increasingly physical. Sam Smith was booked for simulation, and Will Lankshear also saw yellow for a mistimed challenge. Middlesbrough almost doubled their lead in the 87th minute when Morgan Whittaker led a lightning-fast break, only to see his shot cannon off the right-hand post. Late Pressure and Final Whistle In a frantic finale, Wrexham threw everything forward. Callum Doyle forced a late save from Sol Brynn in the 89th minute, while a series of corners kept the Middlesbrough defense on high alert. Tactical fouls led to yellow cards for Dominic Hyam and Doyle as they struggled to contain the hosts' counter-attacks during stoppage time. Ultimately, Middlesbrough held firm to secure a 1-0 victory and advance in the Carabao Cup . It was a performance defined by one clinical moment from Lankshear and a solid defensive display that weathered the late storm from the visitors.
